about.label: ABOUT
about.title: Passionate developer, creator of digital experiences
about.intro: I'm a fullstack developer in work-study, passionate about building modern web applications.
about.bio1: I've been coding since 2022, frontend to backend. Now a fullstack developer at Kollirama, I use my JavaScript expertise and my Master's degree at EPSI to build interfaces that work well.
about.bio2: I've had the opportunity to work on large-scale projects: from developing internal tracking and management tools (Igowall, Igotrack) to designing a queue management application for Hermès. I focus as much on code optimization as on technical documentation to keep projects maintainable.
about.bio3: Outside of work, I build personal projects to try new ideas and keep learning. Other than that, I play a fair amount of video games ;)
